description: Domain Inspector metrics from fastly-exporter. Requires the account to be entitled to Domain Inspector and the product enabled on the service; the exporter then polls it automatically with no flag.

panels.title: DOMAINS WITH TRAFFIC
panels.description: Domains with a non-zero request rate in the selected window. Uses rate() rather than counting every series ever seen, so a domain that has gone quiet drops out.

targets.expr: 8 * sum(rate(fastly_domain_edge_resp_body_bytes_total{domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate]) + rate(fastly_domain_edge_resp_header_bytes_total{domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate]))

panels.title: EDGE HIT RATIO

targets.expr: sum(rate(fastly_domain_edge_hit_requests_total{domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate])) / (sum(rate(fastly_domain_edge_hit_requests_total{domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate])) + sum(rate(fastly_domain_edge_miss_requests_total{domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate])))

panels.description: Hits over hits plus misses, which is how the exporter defines fastly_domain_edge_hit_ratio. Computed from the counters so that busy and quiet POPs are weighted by traffic.

targets.expr: topk($topk, 8 * sum(rate(fastly_domain_edge_resp_body_bytes_total{domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate]) + rate(fastly_domain_edge_resp_header_bytes_total{domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate])) by (domain))

panels.title: EDGE HIT RATIO
panels.description: From the fastly_domain:edge_hit_ratio recording rule, which is keyed by domain and service, so a domain attached to more than one service appears once per service. A service with no traffic has no ratio and draws no line.

panels.title: EDGE HIT RATIO BY POP
panels.description: The exporter's own fastly_domain_edge_hit_ratio gauge, which is reported per datacenter. Grouped by datacenter because that is the granularity it is valid at; averaging it across POPs would weight a quiet POP the same as a busy one.

targets.expr: topk($topk, sum(rate(fastly_domain_status_group_total{status_group="4xx", domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate])) by (domain))
topk($topk, sum(rate(fastly_domain_status_group_total{status_group="5xx", domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate])) by (domain))

panels.title: ORIGIN FETCHES
panels.description: fastly_domain_origin_fetches has no _total suffix upstream. Left as the exporter names it.

panels.title: ORIGIN OFFLOAD BY POP
panels.description: The exporter's fastly_domain_origin_offload gauge: response bytes served from the edge against what came from origin. Reported per datacenter, so grouped that way rather than averaged across POPs.

panels.title: ORIGIN 5XX

targets.expr: topk($topk, sum(rate(fastly_domain_origin_status_group_total{status_group="5xx", domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate])) by (domain))

panels.description: Status returned by origin, which is not the same as what the end user saw. A domain can serve 200s from cache while its origin is failing.

panels.title: BYTES TO ORIGIN
panels.description: Request bytes sent to origin, from fastly_domain_bereq_*.

panels.title: HTTP VERSION MIX

targets.expr: sum(rate(fastly_domain_requests_total{domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate])) - sum(rate(fastly_domain_http2_total{domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate])) - sum(rate(fastly_domain_http3_total{domain=~"$domain", service_name=~"$service_name", service_id=~"$service_id", datacenter=~"$datacenter"}[$rate]))

panels.description: HTTP/1.x is derived: total requests minus HTTP/2 minus HTTP/3. The exporter has no HTTP/1 counter for domains.

panels.title: TOTAL DELIVERED vs TO END USER
panels.description: The exporter has both resp_* (total bytes delivered) and edge_resp_* (delivered to the end user). On a shielded service the first reads higher. If these two lines sit on top of each other, shielding is not in play for the selected domains.

list.name: topk
list.label: top N
list.description: How many domains each ranked panel shows.

title: Fastly Top Domains
